## Checklist

- [ ] Safe inputs and logs; no real transcripts, personal/customer details, credentials, or confidential terms.
- [ ] Consequential conclusions trace to supplied evidence or explicit uncertainty.
- [ ] Unknowns are not treated as proven absence or automatic disqualification.
- [ ] Simple founder purchases avoid imposed enterprise requirements.
- [ ] Drafts do not invent urgency, commitments, capabilities, or authorised concessions.
- [ ] Relevant cases and docs are updated; examples are clearly fictional.
- [ ] Installer changes preserve unrelated files in isolated checks, or this is not an installation change.
- [ ] Licence notice is preserved and repository links are accurate.
